archive_root: Extract to a fresh directory; paths retain the original project-relative layout.
deduplication: Byte-identical seal payload copies are omitted; both seal inventories and every original native phase file are retained. Intermediate monitoring snapshots are separately excluded as counted above. Native verify_seal requires an explicitly reconstructed complete seal view.
historical_provenance: Original bytes retain hostnames, usernames, local paths, process identities and historical operational instructions. The public reproduction guide is authoritative for offline use.
